title: Paloma and the Border
author: Zephyrine Okafor
blurb: Lena Iversen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
